title: Current RxSock6 authority and object model
summary: The current reconciled estate is Socket Provider v0.1-dev16 with RxSock6 Socket Provider v0.1-dev3 over rxsock6 0.1.2. TCP6 and UDP6 are sibling-provider routes; native .Inet6Address identity is retained rather than flattened.
invariants: Bundled RxSock remains IPv4-only; IPv6 is supplied side-by-side by RxSock6.
socket6.cls extends socket.cls rather than replacing or copying the stock class contract.
RxSock6 remains a sibling provider below the common Socket Provider boundary; do not fold it into SocketProvider.cls.
The preferred TCP6 and UDP6 routes preserve the native .Inet6Address object, including address-family-specific state.
procedure: Treat v0.1-dev3 / rxsock6 0.1.2 as the current qualified estate, while treating the checked-in GitHub dev1 source as a historical source snapshot until exact dev3 source is synchronized.

provenance.claim: Records Socket Provider dev16, RxSock6 provider dev3 / rxsock6 0.1.2, live TCP6/UDP6 evidence, native Inet6Address preservation, and the separate IPv6 multicast route.
